newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-MOSTOVOI PUNISHED BY CLUB FOR LEAVING PITCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MOSTOVOI PUNISHED BY CLUB FOR LEAVING PITCH.

text.p: Celta Vigo have fined Alexander Mostovoi two million pesetas ($1,400) and excluded the Russian midfielder from the team for eight days as punishment for walking off the pitch during Sunday's game at Sporting Gijon.
Angry team mates had to drag Mostovoi back on to the pitch after he had left in apparent frustration at Celta's poor play.
"It was the straw that broke the camel's back," said Celta president Horacio Gomez.
Mostovoi has since apologised to players and fans for the incident.
